name: Interfaith Marriage
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers to avoid interfaith marriages, emphasizing the importance of maintaining purity in the covenant community. Abraham's charge to avoid Canaanite wives (Genesis 24:3) and the command in Deuteronomy 7:3 to not marry outside God's people highlight the spiritual dangers of such unions. The consequences of disobedience are evident in Ezra 10:2 and Malachi 2:11, where marrying foreign or idolatrous partners leads to sin and profaning the holiness of the LORD. These passages collectively warn that interfaith marriage threatens faithfulness to God and disrupts the spiritual integrity of His people.
